verdict.rationale: Sentry ships AI agent tracing, with conversation replay, LLM call views and dashboards, so routing outputs to human annotation queues is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents annotation queues, human review workflows or labeling of outputs. The 'human handoffs' item refers to agent runtime transitions, not review queues, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling
